payload.title: Deploy the lab front end on merge
payload.description: The lab page is a manual Amplify app built from main via amplify.yml. Follow Papyrus: turn auto-build off where needed and start the Amplify job for the exact commit through OIDC with amplify:StartJob and GetJob only, after the backend it needs. Order matters when a front end depends on a new API. Check hosted mode before publishing.
